subject.title: improve(diagnostics-otel): make agent-duration histograms usable beyond 10s

question: Which default OTel histogram bucket policy should diagnostics-otel ship for duration and context metrics?
rationale: Two open PRs address the same operator problem with different scopes and bucket ranges, and changing exported metric aggregation defaults is an operator-facing policy choice.

options.title: Choose one canonical bucket policy
options.body: Pick either this targeted run/harness/context policy or the broader related duration policy, require real export proof, and merge only the selected implementation.

options.title: Request a combined revision
options.body: Ask for one PR that explains the intended range for each affected histogram family and aligns with Prometheus where maintainers want parity.

options.title: Keep collector-side configuration
options.body: Decline built-in bucket advice for now and leave aggregation boundaries to operator collector configuration.

recommendation.title: Choose one canonical bucket policy
recommendation.body: Pick either this targeted run/harness/context policy or the broader related duration policy, require real export proof, and merge only the selected implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The diagnostics-otel OpenTelemetry migration and lifecycle telemetry history makes this the strongest available owner signal for the default bucket policy decision.
